name: gemma-3-12b-it

resources.recommendedGpu: 1× T4 16GB (quantized) / 1× L4 24GB (full precision) / Apple Silicon M-series 32GB+

notes: 12B instruction-tuned. The laptop-friendly entry point — Vicki Boykis demonstrated running agentic loops on a 2022 M2 Mac with 64GB RAM using a similar Gemma model. For laptop deployment use the QAT (quantization-aware-trained) variant via a separate manifest, or run through llama.cpp instead of vLLM.
